key_findings: 1. OpenWrt Stage 52A Champion v18 on PowerBeam 5AC Gen2 (-67.5 dBm OTA calibrated) achieves 31.221 Mbps Triple-Play goodput (+18.89% vs Stock airMAX Flexible 26.261 Mbps, +31.42% vs FF 8ms 23.756 Mbps, and +40.95% vs FF 5ms 22.15 Mbps) while cutting loaded p50 RTT to 8.602 ms (-55.49%) and loaded p95 RTT to 13.43 ms (-61.40%).

2. airMAX Fixed Frame 5ms (FF 5ms) reduces loaded p50/p95 RTT vs FF 8ms (12.061 vs 15.84 ms p50; 17.181 vs 23.102 ms p95) by tightening the TDD turnaround cycle, but sacrifices aggregate goodput (22.15 vs 23.756 Mbps) due to higher TDD guard/header overhead on 20 MHz PtP.

3. PowerBeam 5AC Gen2 (25 dBi dish, 32 dB F/B) outperforms LiteBeam 5AC Gen2 (23 dBi stamped reflector, 24 dB F/B) at equal path loss by +40.32% goodput (31.221 vs 22.25 Mbps) and -20.37% loaded p50 RTT (8.602 vs 10.802 ms) thanks to the +4.0 dB two-ended antenna gain advantage and +1.5 dB cleaner dish CINR.

4. Quantum-locking ag71xx eth0 BQL limit_min=4542 (3xMTU) to mac80211 fq_quantum=4542 with limit_max=42392 (28xMTU) and dev_weight_tx_bias=2 prevents DMA ring micro-starvation between NAPI ticks, delivering the highest Pareto efficiency on both PowerBeam and LiteBeam.
